comment: C ref: zap.c dobuzz() 4993-5023. A gnome Healer steps beside the closed east door of the start room, drinks a wished-for blessed potion of gain energy so she has the 15 Pw dobreathe() needs, becomes a green dragon and breathes poison gas east with #monster. The gas reaches the door, where the deferred zap_over_floor() call (cast to void) leaves a cloud and absorbs the blast without ending the ray, so closed_door() with range >= 0 bounces it back across the hero and the room. Seed, clock and character chosen independently of the c-diff-b4 examples.
